Maia Mitšulis · The first certified PCM trainer in Estonia

Clarity in communication. Ease in your relationships

I deliver practical tools to understand personality, reduce stress, and communicate better – at work and beyond it

Get Started

Why use PCM?

Misunderstandings, stress, difficult conversations... Communication shouldn´t feel this hard.

Know about perception

How you interpret people and situations

Understand needs

What keeps you motivated and balanced

Realise stress patterns

How communication changes under pressure

PCM (Process Communication Model®) is a set of practical tools that help you understand how people perceive the world, what they need to stay in balance, and how communication changes under stress – so you can communicate more effictivly Result: less misunderstanding, less stress, and clearer conversations – at work and at home How we can work together

Discover Our Comprehensive Communication Training Services

Transforming individuals and teams through effective communication strategies and stress management techniques.

Learn more

Personal PCM Debrief Session

A good start for understanding your communication style, your unique structure of personal strength, and your own way to get energized.

PCM Core Training

A foundational 16 hours program focusing on the Process Communication Model to improve communication skills and personal development.

PCM Profile for Leaders and Leadership Training

A tailored programme for leaders, enhancing their ability to manage stress and foster effective communication within their teams.

Have you ever been nervous before an important talk, not knowing how to handle it?

With PCM in mind, you are there prepared, calm and conscious of yourself and others. You have something to say — with PCM, you know, how exactly to get your message there.

Have you ever felt lack of motivation, not being conscious why something has changed?

PCM has some precise answers and personal lifehacks just for you.

Do you need fast recovery from stress?

Process Communication Model was built on observation and understanding of humans’ stress nature by dr Taibi Kahler starting back there in 1970s. We have it covered.

Did it happen to you speaking the same language with person and thus not understanding each other at the same time?

PCM has simple and structured explanation — once known, you cannot forget it. You are given clear interface of human communication to use day by day.

About Trainer

Nice to meet you! I am Maia Mitšulis, the first and so far the only certified PCM® communication trainer in Estonia. At some point, it felt like a natural next step for me to become communication trainer because I’ve always been drawn to harmony — both in spaces and in mind.

My background is in graphic and interior design, where beauty and function come together to create clarity and ease. So PCM is a great tool to design beautiful and effective relationships.

As a trainer and consultant, I am caring, calm and attentive. I love to create welcoming and light atmosphere where everyone is seen and appreciated, and gets maximum profit of participation in the session.

What Our Clients Say

Thanks to PCM, I can understand my conversation partner and the situation more quickly. This means that less energy is expended and decisions are made more quickly. I did the training with my employees. We got to know each other better and realised that our personalities are a perfect match. This knowledge improves communication and makes us more successful! Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting!

Frequently Asked Questions

What is PCM? PCM® is practical communication and personality model that helps people understand how they and others think, communicate, and react under stress.Developed by psychologist Dr. Taibi Kahler, PCM identifies six personality types that exist in all of us in different combinations. The model shows:
  • how we prefer to communicate
  • what motivates us
  • what we need to stay in balance
  • how stress affects our behavior
  • how to communicate more effectively with different people
What PCM is not
 PCM is not:
  • a personality test that puts you in one box
  • a diagnostic or therapeutic model
  • a tool for labelling or manipulating people
Instead, PCM is about understanding patterns, increasing flexibility, and choosing effective ways to communicate, especially under stress. PCM helps you understand why communication sometimes fails — and how to make it work better. With yourself and with others. 

Is this therapy? 

No, this is process of acqiring of set of practical skills in the field of communication psycology. At the same time, getting know one’s psycological needs, personal structre and other unique patterns often has quite therapeutical effect.

Who is it for?  It is for those people who want to grow their adaptive and emotional intelligence, improve self-management as well as quality of any relationship.Because any good relationship begins with pleasant and effective communication. 

How long is a session / training? 

Your personal debrief session lasts about 2,5 hours, followed by a supportive one-hour meet-up after a month.

PCM Core Training programme lasts 16 hours and can be spread over two or four days. The most effective option is to meet four times, once a week for 4 hours each time.

In what language? I deliver PCM profiling debrief sessions and training in three languages — Russian, Estonian and English. Currently, the PCM questionnaire is available in Russian and English, and I am working on translating it into Estonian.

Online or in-person? 

The PCM profile debrief session can be held online or in person in the Tallinn area. PCM training sessions are available in person anywhere in Estonia. I am also open to international collaboration.

What do teams typically gain from it? 

A comforting atmosphere, mutual understanding, a significant reduction in the number of conflicts, greater satisfaction with the process and results, a more uniform contribution from participants, fewer transitions between teams and a reduced desire to leave the team. Some teams also report a significant acceleration of work processes where PCM can be implemented not only in communication between people, but also in the working flows. For example, this can be seen in the advertising and marketing fields.

records.title: Trainings
records.post_content:
Empower Your Communication Skills

Process Communication Model® (PCM) training for teams and open groups

16 hours · in Estonian, English or Russian · in Tallinn or on-site across Estonia

ask for training dates

What Participants Learn

We practice PCM in four steps 01

To be aware of your personality

Understanding your preferences means you need to be in a good place and how to fulfill those needs. In doing so, you can manage stress and take care of yourself.

02

To recognize what other people do, say, and show

Observing other people´s recognizable behavior reveals their preferences and the best way to approach them.

03

Adapt your communication style

Based on what you observe, you will know what to do, say, and show in response so that you can make a genuine connection that works for you both.

04

To build stronger relationships

Enjoy the benefits of positive daily interactions at work, in meetings, video calls, presentations, social situations – and at home, too.

How teams benefit from PCM training

Measured improvements in how teams work, communicate and feel*

2x fewer conflicts

Fewer misunderstandings and less time lost on miscommunication.

Greater team comfort

Clearer and more effective communication between team members.

Stronger mutual understanding

Better understanding of individual differences and working styles.

More balanced participation

Work contribution becomes more evenly distributed, with more voices actively involved.

Higher satisfaction

Teams feel more satisfied with both collaboration and results.

Stronger team stability

Team members show less desire to leave, creating a more stable and supportive environment.

2x fewer conflicts

Fewer misunderstandings and less time lost on miscommunication.

Greater team comfort

Clearer and more effective communication between team members.

Stronger mutual understanding

Better understanding of individual differences and working styles.

More balanced participation

Work contribution becomes more evenly distributed, with more voices actively involved.

Higher satisfaction

Teams feel more satisfied with both collaboration and results.

Stronger team stability

Team members show less desire to leave, creating a more stable and supportive environment.

* Based on comparative group research
Choose the format that fits your goals, whether you are starting or going deeper

Training formats

Not sure which format fits you? I´ll help you choose.

request training dates

PCM® Core Training

Start here

A practical introduction to the Process Communication Model®.

You will learn to recognise different personality types, adapt your communication, and handle everyday situations with more clarity and ease.

  • 16 hours of training
  • includes your personal PCM profile
  • suitable for individuals and teams

PCM® Leadership

Or start here, if you are a leader or a manager

Learn how to support your team, adapt your leadership style, and create a more trusting and effective communication culture.

  • 16 hours of training
  • includes your personal PCM Leadership profile
  • practical tools for leadership situations
  • understanding team dynamics
  • supporting motivation and wellbeing

PCM® Advanced Training

For those who want to deepen their skills.

Built on the core/leadership training and develops your ability to navigate more complex situations, stress patterns, and communication dynamics.

  • built on the Core Training
  • more practice and real-life application
  • deeper understanding of behaviour and stress

Your personal PCM profile

The training starts with your personal PCM profile. It is a detailed and practical insight into how you communicate, what motivates you, and how you react under stress.

This means you are not just learning a model —
you are learning how it works for you.

This is what makes PCM training deeply personal and immediately applicable.

Example page from your 26-page personal PCM profile

What Our Clients Say

Thanks to PCM, I can understand my conversation partner and the situation more quickly. This means that less energy is expended and decisions are made more quickly. I did the training with my employees. We got to know each other better and realised that our personalities are a perfect match. This knowledge improves communication and makes us more successful! Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting!

records.title: Consultations
records.post_content:
A good start for understanding your communication style, your unique structure of personal strength, and your own way to get energized.

Individual PCM Consultations

Book a consultation

Situations clients bring

You don't need to know anything about PCM. People come with real communication situations they want to understand or improve.

"I feel misunderstood in conversations. Sometimes it hurts so much when the relationship is important"

"I want to communicate more effectively as a leader. I notice that different people in my team respond very differently to the same message"

" I want to know myself better. I'm curious about my communication style and how I can develop it further"

"Certain interactions drain me. Communication with some people is exhausting or tense, and I don't understand why"

"Why people are so f.. serious!? Life is fun!"

"We with N. react differently under stress. In difficult moments, communication becomes more emotional or distant, and it is hart to reconnect"

Types of consultations

Individual

Deep dive in yourself, superpowers and their sources to be discovered

For couples/partners

Best way to discover each other for deep understanding and supportive connection

For leaders

Take it to the next level by combining your strengths with those of the people around you

PCM profile and debrief - how does it work

Are you curious about your personal PCM profile? Look what you get in the session:

Clarity about your personality

Understand your PCM profile and the unique structure of your personality

Insight into how you communicate

Discover your natural way of interacting, perceiving the world, and connecting with others

Understanding your motivation and stress patterns

Learn about your psychological needs and how to stay balanced and energized. 

Practical insights for real-life situations

Explore your communication experiences through the PCM lens and gain practical insight.

Clarity about your personality

Understand your PCM profile and the unique structure of your personality

Insight into how you communicate

Discover your natural way of interacting, perceiving the world, and connecting with others

Understanding your motivation and stress patterns

Learn about your psychological needs and how to stay balanced and energized. 

Practical insights for real-life situations

Explore your communication experiences through the PCM lens and gain practical insight.

Book your session

Step 1

You fill out the PCM questionnaire online

Step 2

You will get a 26-page personal PCM profile when we meet, online or in person (in case you are in Tallinn). Session duration is 1,5-2 hours

Step 3

A follow-up after a month after the session. A chance to revisit you profile, share what you have noticed in practice, ask questions and deepen your practical using of PCM.

Testimonials

Thanks to PCM profiling, I can now understand why sometimes (quite often, actually) it is so hard for me to say "no". And I am now much better at it! Choosing myself consciously and keeping much better balance between me and the demanding world... I did the training with my employees. We got to know each other better and realised that our personalities are a perfect match. This knowledge improves communication and makes us more successful! Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting! My personality profile proved to be unexpectedly insightful and prompted me to reflect on and analyze my life circumstances. Join Us

Take the First Step Towards Transforming Your Communication Today!

Get Started

records.title: What is the Process Communication Model (PCM)?
records.post_excerpt: A clear introduction to the Process Communication Model: its origins, six Personality Types, how PCM works and where to explore it further.

records.title: Six Personality Types
records.post_content:
← Back to PCM

Process Communication Model

Six Personality Types.
All within each of us.

PCM describes six Personality Types, each with its own strengths, preferences and ways of connecting. We all have all six. What differs is their order and how much energy is available to us in each.

These short descriptions offer a first glimpse of what each type brings and how you can make contact.

01 / Six Personality Types

Thinker

People with a lot of Thinker energy are responsible and logical. They look for facts and data.

How to connect with Thinker

  • Provide thorough information
  • Show them you value their work and time
  • Ask for their ideas

02 / Six Personality Types

Persister

People with a lot of Persister energy are dedicated and attentive. They need to be respected for their conviction.

How to connect with Persister

  • Ask for their opinions
  • Invest in mutual respect
  • Show them you appreciate their valuable contributions

03 / Six Personality Types

Harmonizer

People with a lot of Harmonizer energy are warm and compassionate. They want you to feel good and they need to be appreciated for who they are.

How to connect with Harmonizer

  • Create a pleasant atmosphere
  • Show that you appreciate him or her
  • Invite collaboration in a caring setting

04 / Six Personality Types

Rebel

People with a lot of Rebel energy are spontaneous and creative. They bring energy and like to try something new.

How to connect with Rebel

  • Keep it playful and use humor
  • Allow room for new ideas and experiences
  • Be open to spontaneous reactions

05 / Six Personality Types

Promoter

People with a lot of Promoter energy are direct and charming. They always find a way to make things happen.

How to connect with Promoter

  • Skip the small talk and get straight to business
  • Challenge them with promising initiatives
  • Offer them the opportunity to shine

06 / Six Personality Types

Imaginer

People with a lot of Imaginer energy are imaginative and calm. They need to take their time to reflect and to ponder concepts.

How to connect with Imaginer

  • Provide them time and space
  • Give clear instructions
  • Appeal to their imagination

Personality structure

The same six types.
So many different structures.

The colours in each little stack are the same six Personality Types. Change their order, and there are already 720 possible arrangements. In real life, the amount of energy in each type varies too — making each person’s Personality Structure their own.

One of these little stacks follows the same order as yours. Once you have your PCM Profile, you can find it!

One personality, six types

There are no “types of people” here.

These are Personality Types within people. Each of us has a unique Personality Structure, and no type is better than another. Recognising the differences can help us choose a way of communicating that reaches the person in front of us.

You can read more about the model on the PCM page.

Explore your Personality Structure

records.title: PCM Leadership Training
records.post_content:
PCM Leadership Training

Understand different people. Lead with more choice.

A practical 16-hour Process Communication Model® programme for leaders who want to understand what motivates different people, recognise stress earlier and adapt communication to real people and real situations.

16 hours·Personal Leadership Profile·In person ET·EN·RU Book a 20-minute introduction call

Leadership through PCM

Different people need different ways of being led.

PCM gives leaders a practical framework for understanding personality differences, psychological needs, motivation and behaviour under stress.

It also starts with the leader: understanding your own strengths, preferred ways of leading, reactions under stress and patterns you may not notice as quickly in yourself.

The goal is not to learn one “correct” leadership style, but to recognise what is happening — in yourself and in others — and choose a way of communicating that fits the person and the situation.

What participants learn

From understanding people to leading them more consciously

Recognise people faster

Notice communication clues, personality preferences and the first signs that contact is becoming more difficult.

Motivate more precisely

Understand different psychological needs and choose ways of communicating that support motivation and engagement.

Return communication to a constructive track

Recognise early stress and misunderstanding, adapt your approach and reduce the risk of escalation.

Understand yourself as a leader

See your own strengths, preferred leadership patterns, stress responses and ways to stay more effective in difficult situations.

Your Leadership Profile

Your own communication is part of the leadership system.

Before the training, each participant completes the official PCM questionnaire and receives a personal Leadership Profile. It connects the model directly to your own communication, motivation, interaction preferences and patterns under stress.

Personality Structure & strengthsCommunication & interaction preferencesPsychological needs & motivationStress patterns & practical reflection

How the training works

Learn it. Notice it. Try it in real life.

01

Profile

Start with your personal PCM Leadership Profile.

02

Understand

Build a shared language for personality, motivation and stress.

03

Practise

Work individually, in pairs and in groups with practical exercises and cases.

04

Apply

Use the time between sessions to notice patterns in everyday work and try new approaches in real situations.

05

Follow up

Meet again after the training to discuss what happened in practice, ask questions and refine how PCM is used in everyday work.

The goal is not to finish the training and leave the profile on a shelf. Follow-up helps turn PCM into an everyday working tool.

For schools & education

A teacher is a leader, too.

PCM Leadership Training can be used in schools for teachers and school leaders, without turning it into a separate “school version” of the model.

A teacher leads every day: creates a frame, guides learning, motivates, keeps a group together and adapts communication to different people and situations.

PCM gives schools a shared language for understanding what motivates different students, how they take in information, how stress changes behaviour and communication, and what can help restore contact.

For experienced teachers, much of this may already happen intuitively. PCM helps make that knowledge more conscious, easier to discuss and easier to use consistently across a school team.

Format

16 hours with time to apply what you learn

4 × 4 hoursFour meetings with space between them for real-life observation and practice. In personFor organisations, teams and schools. ET · EN · RUThe training can be delivered in Estonian, English or Russian. Practical by designTheory, individual work, pair/group exercises, video analysis and real group cases.

What changes after the training

More options in the moments that matter

Clearer communication

More choice in how you explain, direct, give feedback and build trust with different people.

Earlier recognition of stress

Notice when communication starts to move off track and respond before tension grows.

More conscious motivation

Understand what different people need in order to stay engaged, resourceful and able to contribute.

PCM Leadership Training

Bring a shared language
for leadership
to your organisation.

Tell me about your team, organisation or school. We can look at the context and choose the right way to run the training.

Book a 20-minute introduction call

records.title: Six Languages of Communication Workshop | Tujutaju
records.post_excerpt: A practical PCM workshop with Maia Mitšulis in Estonia. Try six ways of perceiving and communicating in a live group session. In person, 1.5–2 hours, 12–18 participants.

records.title: About
records.post_content:
About Maia

Hello, I’m Maia Mitšulis.

I’m Estonia’s first certified Process Communication Model® (PCM) trainer.

My path

From spaces to the space between people

I began in graphic design and later worked in interior design. I cared about making spaces beautiful, functional and comfortable for the people in them.

Eventually, I became more curious about the space between people: why one person hears support where another hears criticism, and why even a well-meant message can be understood differently from how it was intended. PCM brought structure to that curiosity. It helped me see how differences in perception, motivation and stress play out in conversation, and how our ways of communicating shape the relationships we build.

My insight

Not every conversation leads to a relationship —but every relationship is shaped by conversations.More conscious communication can improve our relationships.

How I work

Understanding grows through experience.

PCM gives us precise language for personality, motivation, communication and stress. In my work, that language becomes most useful when people connect it to situations they recognise and have a chance to practise.

I make room for questions, experiment and humour. The aim is to leave with something you can notice and use in your next conversation, not simply a set of terms to remember.

A moment from a workshop

In a practical session on six ways of communicating, participants tried each one for themselves. Afterwards, they described a shift: the six ways had become something they could experience, not just names on a slide.

They noticed that some ways of communicating came more easily than others. Some were surprised to find that the easiest way was different from the one they had expected. The exercise gave them a new perspective on their own preferences.

“Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting!”

PCM training participant

What matters to me

A precise model, made human

Clarity

To me, PCM is like a periodic table of human relationships. What first looks like endless variety begins to reveal a pattern, and that pattern helps us understand what happens between people.

Practice

PCM is a tool we can use in everyday conversations. That is what “a tool to make a daily difference” means to me: it helps us notice what is happening and gives us the option to choose a way of communicating that fits the person and the moment.

Patterns of our own

We all have the same six Personality Types, yet their different arrangements create a remarkable variety of personality structures. I find that shared foundation and the beauty of each individual pattern equally fascinating.

Beyond training

Still making things

I love photography and the small details it invites me to notice. I pay attention to nuances in conversations, too. I also enjoy making things by hand, and I love to draw. I usually draw on the small pages of a sketchbook, but recently I surprised myself by painting an acrylic canvas about 1.1 by 1.5 metres.

I also play tennis, where I am on the other side of training. My coach notices what I need to develop and finds ways for me to practise through play. It reminds me how much attention and enjoyment matter when we learn.

A first conversation

Let’s get acquainted

If something here resonates with you, I’d be glad to meet. In a free 20-minute introduction call, you can tell me what brought you here, ask me questions and get a sense of how I work. We can see together whether there is a useful next step.
